reasons: CS4221 requires CS3223, which requires CS2102. Since CS2102 is fixed in Sem 6, CS3223 is earliest Sem 7, making CS4221 earliest Sem 8, conflicting with the Sem 6 constraint.
CS4261 is offered only in Sem 1, but the student is in Sem 6 (Y3S2) and future years follow the same schedule, so it cannot be taken in Sem 6 or later.
CS3281 is offered only in Sem 2, so it cannot be taken in Sem 7 (Y4S1).
